question: Where is the six-limbed young goddess situated from the east?
premises: ṣaḍaṅgayuvatī devī is the six-limbed young goddess
pūrvāditaḥ sthitā means situated from the east
inference: The six-limbed young goddess is situated there from the east.
plain_english: There the six-limbed young goddess is situated from the east.
